accepted_pipeline: whole short conversation or complete conversational turns
Qwen3-8B returns FOUND or EMPTY with atomic claims and exact message evidence
ordinary code verifies message coordinates and exact quotes

known_weaknesses.meaning: The reader can answer one part of a multi-part question and omit another part.
A true source-grounded fact from the right topic can still fail to answer the requested field.

product_decision: Ship these two weaknesses visibly in the first playable Pocket i. They become upgrade targets for owners and the community; they must not be described as solved.
claim_boundary: Owner acceptance of one eight-case synthetic English development pipeline for an MVP build. This is not proof of unseen generalization, private-memory quality, networking, or swarm scale.
